name: @kickside/sessions-ui
title: KickSide Sessions
description: Chat session manager web component for kickside/sessions.

wippy.description: Chat session manager and compact chat sidebar. The default manager mode lists the current user's chat sessions through the wippy/session API and supports resume, restart, rename, favorites, preview, and delete. Sidebar mode uses the same data/actions in a compact Claude-style session rail. Emits session-select, artifacts-open, new-chat, and kickside-chat-open for an app-owned workspace controller.

active-session-id.description: Session currently rendered by the app-owned chat panel.

artifacts-active.description: Whether the cross-session artifact gallery owns the adjacent workspace.
